              …

faqs.a:
The residential housing counselor provided for in section 2.2 of the essential home
               repair program is hereby authorized to proceed with the essential home repair program
               and is further authorized to adopt rules and regulations, from time-to-time, in order
               to further clarify and define the program.
(Code 1981, § 14-48; Ord. No. 1576, § 3, 7-2-1979; Ord. No. 2389, § 19, 1-5-1987)
